## Documentation

A service message with a request to disable the content protection of the chat.

Use [`process_chat_protected_content_disable_request`](../../methods/chats/process_chat_protected_content_disable_request.md) to approve or reject it.

### Parameters

- **`is_expired`** (`bool`)
  True, if the request has expired.
